pages.title: A pot over the fire
text: The Hearth Pot is a wide clay pot in a copper cradle. Set it **over heat**: a lit campfire, fire, soul fire, magma, lava or an [Ember Bowl](pulse_lights) right under it. It asks no Pulse at all, so it is a camp's first machine.

Open it, put up to **four ingredients** in the square, and a **bowl** beside them when the meal wants one. A dish takes about **12 seconds** over the fire, quick road fare as little as **8**, and a feast **20**, and the meal comes out on the right.

Every [tribe dish](tribe_dishes), every piece of [road fare](road_fare) and [hearth meal](hearth_meals), and every [feast](feasts) is a Hearth Pot recipe. A meal that wants a bowl or a glass bottle takes it in the seat beside the square. The order of the ingredients does not matter. JEI lists them all under the pot.

Hoppers feed it from the top and sides and take the meal from the bottom, so a pot can keep a camp fed on its own. A hopper puts bowls and bottles in the seat beside the square and everything else in the square. Pack makers can add their own meals as recipes of the hearth type.
